products.name: ThinkPad T14s Gen 2
products.whyThisMachine: ISV-certified RTX Ada drivers mean SolidWorks, AutoCAD, and Revit render and simulate without the random crashes gaming cards throw up on long sessions. The chassis is built to sustain full CPU+GPU load for hours without throttling.
products.specSummary: Workstation-grade CAD rig: certified drivers + 64GB RAM for large assemblies.

products.name: MacBook Pro 14 M4 Pro
products.whyThisMachine: Hardware-accelerated ProRes encode/decode means Final Cut and DaVinci Resolve scrub 4K/8K timelines in real time without proxies. The unified memory shares RAM directly with the GPU, so large color grades don't stutter.
products.specSummary: Real-time 4K/8K editing with hardware ProRes acceleration.

products.name: ROG Strix G531GW
products.whyThisMachine: A consumer RTX GPU tuned for game-engine framerates rather than CAD/render-farm accuracy. Higher refresh display and stronger cooling headroom for sustained gaming sessions than a workstation chassis would give you at this price.
products.specSummary: High refresh-rate gaming with strong 1440p frame rates.

products.name: EliteBook 840 G7
products.whyThisMachine: No discrete GPU means no extra heat or battery drain for tasks like compiling code, running containers, or juggling browser tabs and IDEs. 32GB of RAM keeps Docker and multiple dev servers running smoothly without swapping.
products.specSummary: Efficient all-day dev machine with 32GB RAM and long battery life.

products.name: ZBook Fury 16 G11
products.whyThisMachine: 16GB of workstation VRAM and native Ubuntu/Parrot OS support let you run local LLM inference and fine-tuning jobs without hitting memory ceilings mid-training. Chassis-level cooling is rated for sustained 100% GPU load, unlike thin ultrabooks that throttle within minutes.
products.specSummary: Sustained full-load training runs with certified Linux support.

products.name: Legion Pro 7i
products.whyThisMachine: A top-tier consumer GPU built for high frame rates at 1440p/4K gaming, not for render-farm precision work. Certified refurbished with a full diagnostics pass, so you get flagship gaming performance below new-unit price.
products.specSummary: Flagship gaming performance, certified refurbished pricing.

products.name: G15 5530
products.whyThisMachine: A light discrete GPU is enough headroom for local Docker + occasional GPU-accelerated tooling without paying for workstation-tier drivers you won't use for everyday web development and office work.
products.specSummary: Balanced dev laptop with just enough GPU headroom for local tooling.

products.name: MateBook X Pro
products.whyThisMachine: An ultraportable chassis built for battery life and portability over sustained heavy loads — the right pick for office work and light development, but not for hours of continuous rendering or model training.
products.specSummary: Ultra-thin, long battery life, built for portability-first office work.

products.name: Galaxy Book4 Ultra
products.whyThisMachine: A 3K AMOLED display with wide color coverage matters for accurate color grading, and the RTX 4070 handles GPU-accelerated Premiere/Resolve exports well, though without the ISV certification a full workstation card offers for extreme timelines.
products.specSummary: Color-accurate display paired with GPU-accelerated video export.

products.name: Xiaomi Book Pro 16
products.whyThisMachine: A budget-friendly integrated-graphics machine that's more than enough for browser-based work, general office tasks, and lightweight development — you'd be overpaying for a discrete GPU you won't use for this workload.
products.specSummary: Budget-friendly everyday machine for browsing, office, and light dev work.
